rule_or_pattern: Drop maths-bearing lines: label contains any Latin letter [A-Za-z], any of [=≠≤≥∈∉⊂⊆⊇√∅Ø⟨⟩<>|], or a standalone single Greek letter other than ο/η/ή/Ο/Η/Ή (regex (?<![\w'])(?![οηήΟΗΉ](?![\w']))[Α-Ωα-ωά-ώ](?![\w'])). Keep pure-Greek prose, headings and index lines.
notes: LaTeX commutative-algebra thesis (title about vegetation and noise does not match). Greek prose and index lines read correctly (2, 4, 5, 14-18), but inline maths is misread often: subscripts flattened into digits (I_1/I_2 → 11/12 in 22, 31, 37, 38; x_n → Χη in 3), italic l → 1 (28), h → η (34), h^m → hm (12), ⊉ → 2 or ≠ (37, 38), the fraction in 40 lost. Roughly half of the lines carry maths, so the subset is large but describable; Latin-letter presence catches the subscript cases a single-letter rule would miss (22 'όπου 11 ... στο R').
